name: Baguette Simulator
description: Private iOS simulators with sidebar device creation, renaming, switching, zoom and shutdown. Includes a persistent run switch and 15-minute idle shutdown that preserves data. Requires macOS 15+, Apple Silicon, full Xcode and an iOS runtime.
whenToUse: Only when explicitly requested. Run environment/devices; reuse private devices, never Cindy embedded ones. Reopen with open_viewer. Stuck keys: press(release-input); heal ends apps and needs consent. User controls the run switch; do not re-enable it. Finish with shutdown, not just close_viewer.

environment.description: First reject systems older than macOS 15.0. Read bundled Baguette, Xcode, available iOS runtimes and device types. Call first. Does not download dependencies.

devices.description: List only this plugin’s private device set and states. Call first; never control Cindy embedded devices.

create_device.description: Create a private simulator only when no suitable existing device is available or parallel isolation is needed. Consumes disk. Choose exact runtime and deviceType from environment; reuse logged-in devices across sessions.

boot.description: Boot the exact private device and wait for initialization, up to about 105 seconds. After timeout inspect state. Does not silently heal or restart SpringBoard. Subject to the user run switch. Devices stop after 15 idle minutes by default (configurable: 30/60 minutes or manual only). Device input and actual tool operations renew use; status checks do not.

shutdown.description: Shut down a private device, terminating running apps but preserving device data.

describe_ui.description: Read the accessibility tree with labels and logical-point coordinates. Observe before input; an empty tree is not success.

screenshot.description: Save a screenshot under the plugin screenshots directory and return its absolute path. Open with an image-view tool; analysis may send the image to the model.

heal.description: Explicitly repair iOS 27 Device Hub input failure on the private device. Restarts SpringBoard and terminates apps. Call only after the user accepts that impact; try press(release-input) for stuck keys first.

tap.description: Tap or long-press an observed position. Coordinates and screen size are logical points; observe the result afterwards.

swipe.description: Swipe between observed positions using logical-point coordinates. Observe afterwards.

type_text.description: Paste up to 8000 Unicode characters into an already focused field, replacing the simulator clipboard. Waits for key delivery and release, not App completion. Observe afterwards; use press(release-input) for repeats, never blindly retry or heal.

press.description: Press Home, lock, app switcher or notification-center controls. release-input releases stuck keyboard keys without restarting the simulator or terminating apps; observe afterwards.

install_app.description: Install an already-built local iOS Simulator .app on a private device. May replace an app with the same bundle ID. Does not build projects or download dependencies.

launch_app.description: Launch an installed app; showViewer=false skips the loopback viewer. Otherwise request the current sidebar and check viewer.previewOpened. User-triggered controls: input, rotation/Shake, Home/app switching, uploads/.app install, boot/shutdown, location/motion, status bar and persistent network conditions (restore in panels). Camera uses Mac camera/media; Mac location needs permission. AX/logs, screenshots, recordings/exports may expose app data. OSM receives searches/tiles. Copy/paste replace Mac/guest clipboards. Disclose before opening. Duo needs Xcode/iOS 27.1; hinge/display changes affect app layout. Run switch applies. Idle shutdown: 15m default, 30/60m/manual settings; input/tool use renews, status polls do not. Shutdown ends apps/connections, keeps data. Recovery, key release and 50%–200% zoom included. Switch stops source, boots target; may install/launch last plugin-started app, replacing target's same-bundleId app. App bundle only; no data/credentials copied.

open_viewer.description: Open a booted private device in the sidebar without restarting its app; check previewOpened. Loopback viewer stops on worker exit/disable or one hour without tool calls. User-triggered controls: input, rotation/Shake, Home/app switching, uploads/.app install, boot/shutdown, location/motion, status bar and persistent network conditions (restore in panels). Camera uses Mac camera/media; Mac location needs permission. AX/logs, screenshots, recordings/exports may expose app data. OSM receives searches/tiles. Copy/paste replace Mac/guest clipboards. Disclose before opening. Duo needs Xcode/iOS 27.1; hinge/display changes affect app layout. Run switch applies. Idle shutdown: 15m default, 30/60m/manual settings; input/tool use renews, status polls do not. Shutdown ends apps/connections, keeps data. Recovery, key release and 50%–200% zoom included. Switch stops source, boots target; may install/launch last plugin-started app, replacing target's same-bundleId app. App bundle only; no data/credentials copied.

close_viewer.description: Stop streaming only; the device and apps keep running, subject to idle settings. Use shutdown to end device connections; users can also shut down devices in plugin settings.
